surfaces.claim: Planning readiness is explicit; implementation, deployment acceptance and unrelated release scope are not claimed.

anchors.pattern: No implementation, package installation, schema migration, data migration or federation activation has occurred
Source-code Git, arbitrary file synchronization, PRs, automatic hub election, live cross-provider CDC and concurrent independent schema migrations are outside this release
DEPLOY HOLD remains active until the operator explicitly lifts it

surfaces.claim: BDPv4 mocks-first green, discriminating negative controls and zero-skip barrier precede production work.

anchors.pattern: Prove every required assertion passes against correct controlled mocks and rejects deliberately wrong behavior as expected negative controls inside a passing harness
A deliberately red production suite is not the mock gate
do not move unfinished implementation past a Byrd gate

surfaces.claim: B1-B12 are explicitly unproven blocking outputs, with host-separated evidence and no Phase0 exit inference.

anchors.pattern: Initial status for all B1-B12 is unproven
Every B1-B12 receipt has separate LAB and LEGION evidence rows
All must be accepted before Ph1 production integration begins

surfaces.claim: The plan records the accepted patchable prerelease or community EF10 provider without silently downgrading or inventing a provider.

anchors.pattern: a prerelease or community-fork EF10 provider, patched by this project and contributed upstream as needed, is an accepted dependency
do not downgrade the repository silently or ship a bespoke from-scratch provider

surfaces.claim: Crash windows, restart, lost acknowledgment, idempotent replay and recovery are assigned named outcomes.

anchors.pattern: Inject death after target batch commit before acknowledgement
hub/node restart at each state transition
No automatic retry creates a different commit

surfaces.claim: Concurrent writers, stale heads, simultaneous publication and fenced live mutations have explicit review or retry outcomes.

anchors.pattern: all-three concurrent nonconflicting commits
simultaneous publishers overwrite history
IncomingMergeCannotRaceAdmittedEdit

surfaces.claim: Malformed inputs, missing fields, authorization ordering and exact age and data boundaries are specified.

anchors.pattern: Malformed/unsupported token is401
Missing required fields return400 invalid_request
fake clock for exact15-minute/24-hour age boundaries
decimal/UTC/binary/Unicode edge cases

surfaces.claim: Linux, native Windows, real hosts, the three-peer fixture and every installed first-party plugin are explicit evidence rows.

anchors.pattern: Prove on LAB Linux and LEGION native Windows
each installed first-party plugin
three-logical-peer fixture named FED-ATLAS-H, FED-ATLAS-A and FED-ATLAS-B

surfaces.claim: Branch, lease, migration, maintenance and review lifecycles include request, release, resume, status, cancel or abort, and recovery semantics.

anchors.pattern: FederationBranchLifecycleTests
migration/{plan|dry-run|run|resume|verify|export-project|export-todos|cutover|abort}
owner release/takeover requires explicit authorization

surfaces.claim: Project, branch, connection, host and network isolation are explicit and leakage is a failing condition.

anchors.pattern: cross-project row visible
session selection never leaks between connections
Network isolation must not disrupt unrelated projects

surfaces.claim: Explicit DirectProxy compatibility, old schema quarantine, feature catch-up and binary-swap safeguards are preserved.

anchors.pattern: Preserve DirectProxy behavior for explicit legacy configuration
OldSchemaUnpublishedCommitMergesAfterUpgrade
Test older-schema node quarantine separately from network failure

surfaces.claim: Credentials are excluded from transport and receipts, audit delivery is idempotent, and disclosure controls are test obligations.

anchors.pattern: No endpoint accepts credentials in URL, argv or persisted receipts
payload mismatch is409 audit_id_conflict
ReceiptsAndLogsContainNoCredentials

surfaces.claim: Status, errors, ages, local versus remote heads, audit backlog and unsupported capability are operator visible.

anchors.pattern: Status DTO includes projectId, branch, localHead, publishedHead
unsupported_contract is shown
review/wait ages immediately, with15minute warning and24hour escalation

surfaces.claim: Named FR, TR, TEST and acceptance criteria map to phases and remain pending until evidence exists.

anchors.pattern: The workflow inventory maps the 16 release contracts to phases, U01-U15 and 99 named acceptance cases
ValidateTraceability checks the FR/TR/TEST links
All amended criteria remain pending until the implementation passes the defined gates

surfaces.claim: The plan owns the 86 current definitions and requires prewrite, deltas, plugin responses and readback without phase resumption.

anchors.pattern: The 68 definitions in section 16.2 are the current release contracts
Section 16.4 adds 18 explicitly retained dependencies, for 86 definitions in this plan
Do not resume Phase 0 while definitions remain unresolved

surfaces.claim: Imported state cannot replay business commands or external effects, and empty queues are never treated as success.

anchors.pattern: Incoming data must not re-execute business commands or external effects
a successful result must never be inferred solely from an empty queue
neither unit mocks nor an empty queue substitute for these receipts

surfaces.claim: Plan readiness and historic scores do not release deployment; staged cutover remains separately authorized.

anchors.pattern: Plan approval, historical 98/98 or test success is not that release
Live cutover remains a separate action under DEPLOY HOLD
neither plan approval nor a review score releases it
